title: One-target refinement of a bounded flat augmented tower
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme and $A$ its category of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $E_n$ be bounded-above cochain complexes of $A$, flat in every degree [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], with transitions $t_n:E_n\to E_{n+1}$. Let $T$ be an actual flat telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] and $p_n:E_n\to T$ chain maps satisfying $t_n p_{n+1}=p_n$. There exist bounded-above termwise-flat towers $(R_n,s_n)$ and $(F_n,u_n)$, quasi-isomorphisms $c_n:R_n\to E_n$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], and chain maps $a_n:R_n\to F_n$ satisfying $s_n c_{n+1}=c_n t_n$ and $s_n a_{n+1}=a_n u_n$. There is a chain map $r:\operatorname{Cone}(1-\mathrm{shift}:\bigoplus F_n\to\bigoplus F_n)\to T$ which becomes an isomorphism in the homotopy category, has zero restriction to the shifted summand, and satisfies $(\bigoplus a_n)\,\mathrm{inr}\,r=\operatorname{desc}(c_n p_n)$. Bounded above means that for each stage there is an integer above which all terms vanish; the bound need not be uniform in the stage. No second target or maps to good truncations are asserted.

source.place: Original proof of exists_flat_telescope_arrow_bar_data, finite-subcomplex and one-target bar-enlargement paragraphs, with a relative generator-valued resolution of the input tower by the cone construction of Stacks 06XX; 03EW and 077J supply the generator class.

proof.text: Apply the compact-flat-generator tower resolution to E,t. It gives a bounded-above split tower L and strict natural level quasi-isomorphisms v:L -> E. Augment L into T by v_n followed by p_n; associativity and naturality prove strict compatibility.

Apply compact-flat-generator bar enlargement to L and its augmentation. Obtain R,F,d,a,B,b,e, a degreewise split short complex with first map the telescope differential and second map b, and a homotopy equivalence e:B -> T.

Apply the proved private helper isIso_split_cone_augmentation to the degreewise splitting of the short complex with maps delta and b. It makes the homotopy quotient of the canonical Mathlib descShortComplex augmentation rB:Cone(delta) -> B invertible. The helper contains the complete explicit split-row boundary homotopy and the distinguished-triangle five-lemma argument; it has no sorry and uses only Mathlib.

Define c_n=d_n followed by v_n and r=rB followed by e. Quasi-isomorphisms and homotopy isomorphisms compose. Reassociate the two strict tower identities to prove naturality of c. Mathlib inl_v_descShortComplex_f gives the zero shifted restriction of r; inr_descShortComplex followed by the bar augmentation identity gives the unshifted sum identity, checked on Sigma inclusions.

proof_origin.place: The explicit cone/split-row boundary homotopy is reused to make a morphism of distinguished triangles in the homotopy category, where the triangle five lemma proves the canonical split-cone augmentation invertible. The geometric steps retain the original target-refinement proof.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_telescope_target_refinement (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (E : ℕ → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (t : ∀ n : ℕ, E n ⟶ E (n + 1))
    (hb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((E n).X i))
    (hf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E n).X i))
    (T : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hT : isFlatTelescope Y T) (p : ∀ n : ℕ, E n ⟶ T)
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, t n ≫ p (n + 1) = p n) :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let Q := HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ (R F : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ)
      (s : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ R (n + 1))
      (u : ∀ n : ℕ, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
      (c : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ E n) (a : ∀ n : ℕ, R n ⟶ F n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((R n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ z : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, z < i → IsZero ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((F n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso (c n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ c (n + 1) = c n ≫ t n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, s n ≫ a (n + 1) = a n ≫ u n) ∧
      ∃ r : CochainComplex.mappingCone (flatTelescopeDifferential F u) ⟶ T,
        IsIso (Q.map r) ∧
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl (flatTelescopeDifferential F u)).comp
          (Cochain.ofHom r) (add_zero _) = 0 ∧
        Limits.Sigma.map a ≫
            CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr (flatTelescopeDifferential F u) ≫ r =
          Sigma.desc (fun n : ℕ ↦ c n ≫ p n)
